issue.title: feat(cli): UF01a locale foundation — ko default, --lang/NODEKIT_LANG, resource-backed top-level messages (#96)

repository.name: NodeKit
repository.description: Admin tool authoring client for genomic analysis pipeline (C# / Avalonia)

issue.body:
## Summary

UF01a of the CLI follow-up (OP-NODEKIT-CLI-USABILITY-20261021, issue #96): the locale foundation plus the first resource-backed messages. GUI is out of scope.

- `CliText`: human-output strings come from two neutral resources in the main assembly, `Resources/CliStringsKo.resx` (reference text) and `Resources/CliStringsEn.resx`. A key missing in English falls back to Korean. There are no satellite assemblies and no ICU/culture lookups, so an invariant-globalization package gives the same result.
- The language is an `AsyncLocal` scope opened around each `CliApp.Run`. `CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture` is never changed, so repeated or parallel runs in one process don't leak the language into each other.
- `CliLanguageSelector` resolves the language in this order: `--lang <v>` / `--lang=<v>` (once, before or after the command; stripped before subcommand option parsing), then `NODEKIT_LANG`, then the default `ko`. OS `LANG`/`LC_ALL` is ignored on purpose, so an English OS still gets the existing Korean UX.
  - Supported values are any whose primary subtag is `ko` or `en` (`ko-KR`, `en_US.UTF-8`, …).
  - An unsupported, empty, missing or duplicate `--lang` is an exit 2 usage error, and the command does not run.
  - An unsupported `NODEKIT_LANG` prints one warning line to stderr and continues in Korean.
- Moved to resources in this stage:
  - usage text: top-level, `function-recipe`, `validate`, `render`, `recipe create` and `function-recipe validate`
  - errors: unknown command, plus the shared `CliOptionParser` errors (unknown option, missing value, duplicate option)
  - `render --out` / `--format` errors and the `function-recipe validate` success line
- Korean output is byte-identical except for one new line in the top-level usage that documents `--lang`.
- `docs/NODEKIT_CLI_USAGE.md` §1-2 documents the precedence, supported values, fallback and what never depends on the language.

## Remaining scope (not hidden)

The interactive wizards, submit/receipt progress, and validator rule messages are still Korean-only. That is roughly 1.2k Korean literals across about 40 `NodeKit.Cli` files plus the shared `Authoring`/`Validation` sources. They move in later UF01 stages on #96, using the same original and pair.

## Invariants (U02)

Recipe/FunctionRecipe file bytes, the raw-spec render bytes (the real submit payload), JSONL keys and values, and exit codes do not depend on the language. Paths and user values are never translated.

## Verification (seoy, clean tree at this head)

- `dotnet restore --locked-mode`, `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`, Release build with WarningsAsErrors + EnforceCodeStyleInBuild: 0 warnings, 0 errors
- `CliLocalizationTests` 40/40. They cover:
  - resource key and `{n}` parity, with no Hangul in English values
  - default Korean, `--lang` positions and forms, precedence, and the env warning
  - exact usage-error texts
  - render/validate exit codes and byte invariance in ko vs en
  - no leak across sequential runs or 64 parallel runs; scope nesting
- Mutants killed 2/2: dropping the scope restore makes 1 test fail; disabling the English lookup makes 14 fail.
- `PublishedCliProcessTests.English_ActualProcessSmoke` runs on the real package:
  - `--lang en --help` and `NODEKIT_LANG=en_US.UTF-8 validate --help` print English with no Hangul and an empty stderr.
  - `--lang fr` exits 2.
  - `function-recipe validate` in ko and in en leaves identical saved bytes.
- Full `NodeKit.Cli.Tests` against `scripts/package-cli.sh` pkg-a: 1220 total, 0 failed, 2 skipped (the allowed live classes); `check-cli-test-report.py` PASS
- `verify-cli-package.py` PASS. The package rebuild was reproducible at the first head (same sha256 twice).

Writer does not merge. Next: the existing paired Guardrail runs an exact-head independent review, then central handles Codex, threads and landing.

body:
## UF01a progress: locale foundation in PR #144 (writer: Operator, OP-NODEKIT-CLI-USABILITY-20261021)

PR #144 (head `dcac810e`, CI 4/4) adds the foundation:

- `--lang ko|en` / `NODEKIT_LANG`, with Korean as the default
- neutral ko/en resx, with en→ko key fallback
- an AsyncLocal-scoped language, so nothing leaks between runs

It also moves these messages to resources:

- usage text: top-level and `function-recipe`, plus `validate`/`render`/`recipe create`/`function-recipe validate`
- unknown command/option, missing value and duplicate option errors
- `render --out`/`--format` errors
- the `function-recipe validate` success line

Precedence, supported values and fallback are documented in `docs/NODEKIT_CLI_USAGE.md` §1-2. **This is not issue completion.**

### Exact residual (still Korean-only at `dcac810e`)

The counts are source lines containing a Hangul string literal (Grep, 1193 lines across 63 files). A count can include comments, catalog data or exception text, so each later stage must classify its lines before moving them.

| Area | Files (Hangul-literal lines) |
|---|---|
| recipe create wizard | RecipeCreateFlow 102, BeginnerGuideFlow 170, AuthoringModeSelector 43, RecipeMethodQuestionDetailCatalog 46, MethodRecommendationPresenter 48, RecipeCreateCommand 20, RecipeCreateInteractiveRunner 18, PackageCandidatePresenter 7, BuildDependenciesAdvisor 3, SourceBuildBaseImageAdvisor 7, RuntimeProfileHygieneAdvisor 5, BaseImageEngineMismatchChecker 6, BaseImageCatalog 3, DockerfileContentImporter 10, ImageDigestAutoResolveHelper 7, RecoveryDisposition 1 |
| shared authoring catalogs (linked from src/Authoring) | RecipeFieldCatalog 62, RecipeAuthoringSession 26, RecipeMethodRecommender 27, RecipeMethodCatalog 20, InputOutputPresetCatalog 14, InstallCommandParser 8, RecipeMethodQuestionCatalog 6, SourceBuildProfileCatalog 4, FormatNormalizer 3, ChannelNormalizer 2, RoleNormalizer 1, ChangeMethodDecision 1, RecipeRenderer 1, ResourceContract 1 |
| function-recipe | ToolFunctionRecipeCreateFlow 64, ToolFunctionRecipeFieldApplier 26, ToolFunctionRegistrar 26, ToolFunctionRecipeCreateCommand 11, ToolFunctionSourceMaterializer 9, ToolFunctionRecipeSubmitCommand 5, ToolFunctionRecipeRenderCommand 2, ToolFunctionSubmissionPreflight 1 |
| submit / receipt / operations | SubmitCommand 84, LocalOperationStore 47, ReceiptCommand 37, RegistrationStore 26, ToolSpecOperationRunner 12, SourceSnapshot 6, BuildErrorMessages 21 |
| file I/O / resolvers | AtomicFileWriter 16, AuthoringFileLoader 14, PublicRegistryImageDigestResolver 14, HarborImageDigestResolver 8, MappedHarborImageDigestResolver 3 |
| validation rule messages (shared src/Validation) | RecipeValidator 28, ToolFunctionRecipeValidator 17, DockerfileStructureValidator 11, PackageVersionValidator 10, ImageUriValidator 7, RequiredFieldsValidator 5, RecipeValidationPipeline 2, NullCollectionElementValidator 1 |
| **machine contract — must not be translated** | SubmitJsonlRecord 4, ReceiptJsonlRecord 1. These are review items: confirm each line is a comment or a human-only field before touching anything, because JSONL keys and values stay language-independent (U02). |

The single remaining line in each of CliApp, CliOptionParser and CliText is a comment, not user output.

### Proposed next stages (same original/pair, one modifying PR at a time, each after the previous one lands normally)

1. **UF01b**: submit/receipt human output and file I/O errors.
2. **UF01c**: the function-recipe create/submit flow.
3. **UF01d**: the recipe create wizard plus the shared authoring catalogs. `LocalizedText` already exists in `src/Authoring`, so reuse it rather than adding a second mechanism.
4. **UF01e**: validation rule messages. Rule IDs and fields stay unchanged.

**Open question for central:** do the validator messages shared with the GUI (`src/Validation`, `src/Authoring`) belong in CLI resources or in a shared resource? The GUI is out of scope, so UF01a did not touch them.

## UF01a landed; promote the next bounded stage

PR #144 exact head `dcac810edb37a936568c5fdbd1d9245cb8005134` passed the existing paired Guardrail (P0–P2=0), current-head Codex completed clean, unresolved review threads were 0, and required PR CI was green. It was normally squash-merged to `main` as `3f44180f1916236c9945ea3b7cfaf645905d4371` at 2026-10-21T17:32:16Z; main Verify and CodeQL both completed successfully.

Disposition: **PROMOTE / REQUESTED_NOT_RECEIVED** for the existing `OP-NODEKIT-CLI-USABILITY-20261021` Operator to continue the next bounded UF01 stage from main `3f44180f…` on this same issue, preserving one modifying PR and the existing paired Guardrail. UF01a is landed, but the whole #96 / README / Ubuntu 22.04 no-SDK package / Korean Word manual scope is not complete. A genuine fresh own CLAIM is still required before reporting ACTIVE; this record is not a worker receipt.

issue.title: feat(cli): UF01b receipt human output to ko/en resources (#96)

repository.name: NodeKit
repository.description: Admin tool authoring client for genomic analysis pipeline (C# / Avalonia)

issue.body:
Stage UF01b (first slice) of #96, per the staged plan in [#96 comment](https://github.com/HeaInSeo/NodeKit/issues/96#issuecomment-6311757135). Base: main `3f44180f` (UF01a, PR #144).

## What changes
- `nodekit receipt watch|cancel`: usage, stderr diagnostics, the stdout header, image digest and final-state lines, and the event prefixes (`[성공]`/`[빌드 시작]`/`[실행 중]`/`[관측]`) now come from `CliStringsKo.resx` / `CliStringsEn.resx` (30 keys, `Receipt_*`).
- New `CliText.FormatMachine(key, args)` always formats the reference Korean text. It is used wherever the same sentence also goes into a `nodekit.receipt.v1` JSONL `message` field, so **JSONL bytes and exit codes do not depend on `--lang` (U02)**.
- Korean output is unchanged: each Korean resource value is the previous literal verbatim.

## Tests
- `ReceiptJsonlP05Tests.Cancel_Language_ChangesHumanStderrOnly_JsonlBytesAndExitIdentical` covers 3 cases: cancel sent, cancel RPC failure, and an already-terminal refusal. Each case checks that stdout JSONL bytes and the exit code are the same under ko and en, that stderr follows the language, and that the receipt file is unchanged.
- `CliLocalizationTests.LangOption_SelectsEnglish` has a new case: `receipt --help --lang en` prints English usage with no Hangul.
- Mutant: switching `FormatMachine` to `Format` in `ReceiptCommand` makes all 3 new cases fail. It was reverted.

## Local gates (seoy, exact head)
- restore `--locked-mode` 0, `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` 0, Release `-warnaserror` + EnforceCodeStyle 0 errors.
- `package-cli.sh --version 0.0.0-ci` sha256 `6fc0faba57d24fc722896b70e0a139dde927159db3f9924742151a5cae6ae57a`, `verify-cli-package` PASS.
- NodeKit.Cli.Tests against the package: 1224 total, 1222 pass, 0 fail, 2 skip (the allowed live classes). `check-cli-test-report` PASS.

## Not in this slice (exact residual, still Korean-only)
- `ReceiptCommand` line 147: the invalid receipt path message. It is an `OperationStoreError` message that also goes into JSONL, so it moves with LocalOperationStore.
- `ReceiptCommand.FollowUpCommand`: the unquotable-path wording. It is shared with SubmitCommand.
- The rest of the UF01b area is unchanged: SubmitCommand, LocalOperationStore, RegistrationStore, ToolSpecOperationRunner, SourceSnapshot, BuildErrorMessages (`src/Grpc`), AtomicFileWriter, AuthoringFileLoader and the image digest resolvers. Several of these messages also reach submit JSONL, so they need the same human/machine split.

This is not issue completion. Writer does not merge, request Codex, or resolve threads.

issue.title: test(cli): pin receipt JSONL language invariance and en watch output (#96)

repository.name: NodeKit
repository.description: Admin tool authoring client for genomic analysis pipeline (C# / Avalonia)

issue.body:
UF01b follow-up for #96. This adds the two P3 items from the independent review of the receipt slice (PR #145). **Test-only: no production change.**

## What the tests pin

- **P3-U02-PIN.** Five receipt paths put a message into the `nodekit.receipt.v1` JSONL `message` field: watch-stopped, cancel-aborted, cancel-timeout, endpoint-unusable and second-image-digest-missing. Each now runs under `ko` and `en`. The stdout JSONL bytes and the exit code must be identical. Only stderr follows the selected language. Under `ko` alone, `Format` and `FormatMachine` return the same text, so the old `ko`-only tests could not tell them apart.
- **P3-PREFIX-EN.** Human `receipt watch` under `en` now checks the exact lines: the header, the `[build started]`/`[running]`/`[observed]`/`[succeeded]` prefixes, the digest line and the final line. It also checks that stdout has no Hangul.

Files: `tests/NodeKit.Cli.Tests/ReceiptJsonlP05Tests.cs` and `tests/NodeKit.Cli.Tests/ToolFunctionSecondImageBuildP07Tests.cs`.

The second-image test re-watches the same receipt, which is terminal after the first watch. It runs `ko` twice before `en`, so the comparison is between two re-watches of the same state.

## Evidence (seoy, Rocky8, SDK 10.0.201)

- restore locked 0, format 0, Release TreatWarningsAsErrors + EnforceCodeStyle: 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- New cases 6/6 pass.
- Production mutants 8/8 killed. Each failed only its intended case:
  - `FormatMachine`→`Format`/`Get` swaps at the endpoint, second-B, watch-stopped, aborted and timeout sites.
  - Hard-coded Korean for the running prefix, the created prefix and the final line.
  - The source was restored afterwards and verified by sha256.

## Correction for Codex r4348819364 (P1), commit 55ed2c7

The first head used 500 ms user-cancel timers. Under load those could fire before the fake server reached the intended state. The pins now cancel at observed points instead:

- watch-stopped cancels once the CLI has written the state record, and the test requires exactly one state record plus the completed record.
- cancel-aborted cancels once the fake has recorded the cancel RPC (new `FakeBuildService.CancelReceived`). cancel-timeout must reach the fake too.
- A point that is never reached ends the run after 30 s and fails on an explicit barrier assertion. There is no skip, no added delay and no parallelism change.
- `MarkerSignalWriter` moves unchanged from `SubmitCancelTimeoutP05Tests` to `Fakes/` so both classes share it.

Evidence on seoy at 55ed2c7:

- format 0, and the Release WAE build has 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- `ReceiptJsonlP05Tests` + `SubmitCancelTimeoutP05Tests` 51/51, plus the second-B case 1/1. Under 128 busy-loop burners, 10/10 runs pass.
- A barrier mutant fails watch-stopped (1 record instead of 2). It sets the watch barrier to an already-completed task, so the cancel fires immediately.
- Package 0.0.0-ci `5595592b…` passes verify-cli-package. NodeKit.Tests 501/501. The full CLI suite against the package is 1230 total / 1228 pass / 0 fail / 2 allowed skip, and check-cli-test-report passes.

## Not in this PR

The remaining UF01b work stays open on #96: the human/machine split in submit/operation-store, `ReceiptCommand`'s invalid-path message, and the `FollowUpCommand` wording.

issue.title: feat(cli): localize receipt invalid-path and follow-up wording (UF01b, #96)

repository.name: NodeKit
repository.description: Admin tool authoring client for genomic analysis pipeline (C# / Avalonia)

issue.body:
Part of #96 (UF01b). Bounded slice: the two receipt residuals listed in #145/#147.

## Change
- **Invalid receipt path** (`ReceiptCommand`, OS-rejected path such as NUL): text moved to `Receipt_InvalidPath` (ko/en). stderr follows `--lang`. The JSONL `message` keeps the reference Korean text via `CliText.FormatMachine`, so stdout bytes and the exit code do not change with the language (U02).
- **Not-runnable follow-up wording** (`FollowUpCommand`): moved to `Receipt_FollowUpUnquotable`. `FollowUpCommand` keeps the reference text, because the same text also reaches **submit** JSONL messages (`WatchHint`). New `FollowUpCommandHuman` is used only for receipt human output (watch-stopped, cancel-sent). Only the not-runnable wording follows the language; the command, verb and path are unchanged, and a quotable path gives the same runnable command.
- Each Korean resource value is the previous literal verbatim.

## Tests
- `ReceiptJsonlP05Tests.InvalidReceiptPath_Language_ChangesHumanStderrOnly_JsonlBytesIdentical` (watch, cancel): ko vs en stdout JSONL bytes and exit 2 identical, reference message in JSONL, stderr in the selected language, no RPC.
- `ReceiptReentryP05Tests.FollowUpCommand_Unquotable_MachineIsReference_HumanFollowsLanguage`: machine form is the reference text under en; human form is English under en and equals the machine form under ko; quotable paths unchanged.

## Not in this PR (exact residual, next UF01b slice)
SubmitCommand, LocalOperationStore, RegistrationStore, ToolSpecOperationRunner, SourceSnapshot, BuildErrorMessages, AtomicFileWriter, AuthoringFileLoader and the digest resolvers. SubmitCommand call sites still use the reference text, so submit bytes are unchanged.

No production change outside `ReceiptCommand.cs` and the two resx files.

issue.title: feat(cli): localize submit start banner (UF01b, #96)

repository.name: NodeKit
repository.description: Admin tool authoring client for genomic analysis pipeline (C# / Avalonia)

issue.body:
## Summary

UF01b.submit-banner (refs #96, does not close it). Moves the human-readable start banner printed by `SubmitCommand.PrintBanner` to the existing ko/en CLI resources:

- ToolSpec start line, `도구`/Tool line
- ToolFunction second-image start line, `함수`/Function line, base image (A) and base ToolSpec (C1) lines
- receipt/request ID line
- injected-client label

Korean resource values are the previous literals byte for byte (including the two-space indent). The URL, tool/function name and version, digests A/C1, receipt path and request ID are passed through as format arguments unchanged. The `jsonl` early return is unchanged, so JSONL bytes, exit codes, RPCs, protocol, identity and receipt semantics do not change.

New keys (same names and placeholders in `CliStringsKo.resx` and `CliStringsEn.resx`): `Submit_BannerStart`, `Submit_BannerTool`, `Submit_BannerSecondImageStart`, `Submit_BannerFunction`, `Submit_BannerBaseImage`, `Submit_BannerBaseToolSpec`, `Submit_BannerReceipt`, `Submit_InjectedClientLabel`.

## Tests (SubmitCommandTests)

- `Submit_Banner_ToolSpec_Language_*` (injected client with and without `--url`): exact ko and en banner prefixes
- `Submit_Banner_ReceiptLine_Language_*`: exact receipt line with the same path and request ID in ko and en
- `Submit_Banner_Jsonl_Language_*`: no banner in jsonl, identical stdout bytes and exit across ko/en (legacy and receipt paths)
- `Submit_Banner_SecondImage_Language_*`: exact ToolFunction banner with A/C1 digests in ko and en, plus jsonl byte/exit identity

Test-first: against base `SubmitCommand.cs` with the new resx, 4 of 5 new tests failed on the en assertions; the ko pins and JSONL invariance passed. After the change, 5 of 5 pass. Five production mutants were killed (arg swap, FormatMachine for start, hard-coded label, receipt arg swap, disabled jsonl early return).

Left for later: watch/progress/cancel/timeout/store messages, README, the Ubuntu 22.04 kit and the final manual.
